annotations.title: LinkedIn suggested bid and budget range

description: LinkedIn’s OWN suggested bid and daily-budget range for a specific audience — the suggested bid with a low/mid/high range, the hard bid limits, and the minimum, default and maximum daily budget, all in the ad account’s currency. Use it before proposing a number to a user instead of guessing what LinkedIn costs, and pair it with linkedin_audience_count to answer "can we afford this audience?" in one go. Below LinkedIn’s minimum bid it says delivery "may be poor" for Sponsored Update campaigns and is impossible for every other format. These are ESTIMATES for this audience, not prices, and nothing is committed until a campaign is activated with set_linkedin_ads_status(confirm:true). Read-only, 0 credits.

adAccountId.description: LinkedIn ad account id; its currency is the default for the estimate

countryCode.description: two-letter country code for the pricing market, e.g. US

currency.description: ISO currency code for the estimate, e.g. USD

dailyBudget.description: daily budget to check against LinkedIn's limits, in the account currency

include.description: targeting facets ANDed in, e.g. {titles, industries}; same shape as create_linkedin_ads_campaign include

locations.description: geo URNs or ids for the audience, from search_linkedin_ads_targeting

objectiveType.description: optional — LinkedIn prices some objective/optimization combinations and not others

targetingCriteria.description: raw LinkedIn targeting object; overrides locations and include
